title: Not All Samples Should Be Utilized Equally: Towards Understanding and Improving Dataset Distillation
reasoning: The paper is a technical study focused on dataset distillation and optimization techniques in computer vision. It investigates sample difficulty using metrics like GraDN and proposes a method called Sample Difficulty Correction (SDC). The content is strictly mathematical and experimental regarding machine learning performance on image datasets, with no mention of religious, moral, or ethical topics.
